# Spend-first UI visual audit — 2026-11-22

These screenshots were generated by CI in real headless Chrome at 1440×850 using **synthetic usage data only**. They contain no user usage records.

- `01-overview.jpg` — first viewport: estimated spend, average/day, top provider/model, blended cost, token context and spend trend.
- `02-provider-models.jpg` — spend-by-provider and spend-by-model ranking, using content-height cards.
- `03-costly-sessions.jpg` — top five cost bars plus cost-ranked session detail table.
- `04-card-options.jpg` — per-card visualization options remain accessible.
- `05-settings.jpg` — dashboard settings dialog.

Validated in GitHub Actions run 44986603550:
- Ubuntu: PASS
- Windows: PASS
- populated Chrome: PASS
- all widget bodies use `overflow-y: visible`; wheel events move the document rather than nested panels.

The numbers shown are API-equivalent estimates from synthetic data, not subscription billing and not actual user spend.
